otp.title: OTP and Banking Fraud
otp.explanation: The message contains signals related to OTP or banking fraud. These signals do not confirm fraud. Verify the request independently before taking action.
actions: Never share your OTP, UPI PIN, CVV or banking password with anyone.
If you disclosed banking credentials, contact your bank immediately through its official contact channel and ask what protective action is required.
If an unauthorized transaction or financial loss occurred, call 1930 promptly and report it at https://cybercrime.gov.in/.
Keep transaction IDs, suspicious messages and other relevant evidence for reporting.
precautions: Do not approve unexpected UPI collect requests.
Do not install remote-access applications at an unknown caller's request.
Do not click unverified banking links.
Never enter your UPI PIN to receive money.

kyc.title: Fake KYC and Aadhaar Fraud
kyc.explanation: The message contains signals associated with KYC or identity-verification scams. Verify the request with the relevant institution using independently obtained contact details.
actions: Contact your bank or service provider through its official website or application to verify the KYC request.
Use the official UIDAI website for Aadhaar-related information.
Do not submit additional credentials or documents until the request is independently verified.
precautions: Never disclose Aadhaar OTPs to unauthorized entities.
Do not upload identity documents to unknown websites.
Do not trust messages threatening immediate account suspension without independent verification.

sources.name: UIDAI Aadhaar Usage - Dos and Don'ts

job.title: Fake Job and Task Scams
job.explanation: The message contains signals associated with suspicious job offers or task-based earning schemes. Verify the employer and payment conditions independently.
actions: Verify the employer through its official website and independently obtained contact details.
Check the job description, payment conditions and organization before sharing documents or making payments.
If you transferred money, contact your bank or payment provider immediately.
For financial cyber fraud, call 1930 promptly and report the incident at https://cybercrime.gov.in/.
precautions: Be cautious of registration fees, security deposits and advance payments.
Do not share banking passwords, OTPs or UPI PINs with recruiters.
Do not trust guaranteed earnings without verifying the organization.
Do not share identity documents with unverified recruiters.

loan.title: Loan and Advance-Fee Scams
loan.explanation: The message contains signals associated with suspicious loan offers or advance-fee requests. Verify the lender and its association with an RBI-regulated bank or NBFC.
actions: Check the lender's association with an RBI-regulated bank or NBFC through that institution's official website.
Review the Key Fact Statement, interest rate, charges and loan terms before accepting an offer.
If you shared banking information or noticed unauthorized transactions, contact your bank immediately.
If money was lost through cyber fraud, call 1930 promptly and report the incident at https://cybercrime.gov.in/.
If a suspicious application accessed your personal information, review its permissions and seek help from your bank or a trusted technical professional.
precautions: Do not pay unknown agents who guarantee loan approval.
Avoid downloading loan applications from SMS or social-media links.
Be cautious of applications requesting unnecessary access to contacts, call logs, files or media.
Do not share OTPs, UPI PINs or banking passwords.

lottery.title: Lottery and Prize Scams
lottery.explanation: The message contains signals associated with unexpected lottery winnings or prize claims. Verify the announcement directly with the organization before responding.
actions: Verify the announcement through the organization's independently obtained official contact details.
Do not make payments or disclose personal information to claim an unexpected prize.
Preserve the message, sender details and transaction records if you suspect fraud.
If you transferred money, contact your bank immediately, call 1930 promptly and report the incident at https://cybercrime.gov.in/.
precautions: Do not pay unexpected fees to claim a prize.
Do not share identity documents or banking details with unknown contacts.
Do not trust unexpected prize announcements without independent verification.
Do not click unknown prize-claim links.

digital_arrest.title: Digital Arrest and Government Impersonation
digital_arrest.explanation: The message contains signals associated with threats or impersonation of government and law-enforcement authorities. Verify any official communication independently.
actions: End suspicious calls and independently verify the caller's identity through the department's official contact details.
Do not transfer money or disclose financial information because someone threatens arrest or legal action.
Preserve call details, messages, phone numbers and transaction records where available.
If money was transferred, contact your bank immediately, call 1930 promptly and report the incident at https://cybercrime.gov.in/.
precautions: Do not transfer money to settle alleged criminal cases under pressure.
Do not share banking credentials, OTPs or UPI PINs.
Do not follow instructions to remain on video calls or keep the incident secret.
Do not trust callers merely because they display official-looking documents, logos or identification.

general.title: General Cyber Safety
general.explanation: No specific configured scam category was identified. This does not establish that the message is genuine or safe.
actions: Verify the sender through an independent, trusted channel.
Avoid sharing sensitive information until the request is verified.
If you shared banking credentials, contact your bank immediately.
If you suspect financial cyber fraud, call 1930 promptly and report it at https://cybercrime.gov.in/.
precautions: Do not click suspicious links.
Never share OTPs, UPI PINs or passwords.
Do not install applications sent by unknown contacts.
Be cautious of messages creating urgency, fear or promises of unexpected rewards.

url.title: Suspicious URL and Phishing Protection
url.explanation: The URL contains one or more configured risk indicators. These signals do not confirm that the website is fraudulent. Verify the domain independently before interacting with it.
actions: Do not open suspicious links or enter passwords, OTPs, UPI PINs or banking details.
Visit the institution's official website by typing its known address yourself.
Check the exact domain for spelling changes, extra words and misleading subdomains.
If you entered banking credentials, contact your bank immediately through its official contact channel.
If money was lost through cyber fraud, call 1930 promptly and report it at https://cybercrime.gov.in/.
Preserve the suspicious URL and relevant messages as evidence.
precautions: Do not assume HTTPS means a website is legitimate.
Do not trust a website simply because its URL contains a familiar company or bank name.
Avoid shortened links when their destination cannot be independently verified.
Never enter OTPs, passwords or financial information on an unverified website.
Do not download applications or files from suspicious websites.
